import pandas as pd


def _null_safe_eq(a: pd.Series, b: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """NULL vs NULL -> equal; NULL vs non-NULL -> not equal."""
    both_null = a.isna() & b.isna()
    eq = a == b
    eq = eq.fillna(False)
    return eq | both_null


def _get_input(inputs: dict, name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Case-insensitive lookup of input relation by name."""
    if name in inputs:
        return inputs[name]
    lower_map = {k.lower(): k for k in inputs.keys()}
    key = lower_map.get(name.lower())
    if key is not None:
        return inputs[key]
    raise KeyError(name)


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    dim = _get_input(inputs, "DIM_STORE").copy()
    stg = _get_input(inputs, "STG_STORE_FULL").copy()
    batch = _get_input(inputs, "BATCH_CONTROL").copy()

    b = batch["batch_date"].iloc[0]

    # DISTINCT on the staging snapshot
    S = stg[["store_id", "region", "format"]].drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # current rows of DIM_STORE
    current_mask = dim["is_current"] == 1
    current = dim.loc[current_mask, ["store_id", "region", "format"]].copy()

    current_ids = set(current["store_id"])
    S_ids = set(S["store_id"])

    # merge S with current attrs to compare
    merged = S.merge(
        current, on="store_id", how="left", suffixes=("_s", "_c")
    )

    region_eq = _null_safe_eq(merged["region_s"], merged["region_c"])
    format_eq = _null_safe_eq(merged["format_s"], merged["format_c"])
    has_current = merged["store_id"].isin(current_ids)

    attrs_equal = region_eq & format_eq

    # store_ids whose current row's attributes differ from staging -> close + reinsert
    changed_ids = set(merged.loc[has_current & ~attrs_equal, "store_id"])

    # store_ids that have a current row but are absent from S entirely -> close only
    closed_due_to_absence = current_ids - S_ids

    close_ids = closed_due_to_absence | changed_ids

    # Build the set of store_ids that need a brand-new inserted row:
    #   - those with a changed current row (new version)
    #   - those with no current row at all (new store or reactivated store)
    new_or_reactivated_ids = S_ids - current_ids
    insert_ids = changed_ids | new_or_reactivated_ids

    insert_mask = S["store_id"].isin(insert_ids)
    insert_df = S.loc[insert_mask, ["store_id", "region", "format"]].copy()
    insert_df["eff_start_date"] = b
    insert_df["eff_end_date"] = pd.NA
    insert_df["is_current"] = 1

    # Apply closing updates to existing DIM_STORE rows
    dim_updated = dim.copy()
    close_row_mask = (dim_updated["is_current"] == 1) & (
        dim_updated["store_id"].isin(close_ids)
    )
    dim_updated.loc[close_row_mask, "eff_end_date"] = b
    dim_updated.loc[close_row_mask, "is_current"] = 0

    result = pd.concat([dim_updated, insert_df], ignore_index=True, sort=False)

    cols = ["store_id", "region", "format", "eff_start_date", "eff_end_date", "is_current"]
    result = result[cols]

    return {"dim_store_out": result}
